mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM TB_CL_CLOSE WHERE close_ym=#{month} AND close_stat_cd='CLOSE')

SELECT hist_id,trgt_tbl_nm,trgt_key,chg_item_nm,bfr_val,aft_val,reg_dttm FROM TB_SY_CHG_HIST WHERE (trgt_tbl_nm='TB_HR_DEV' AND chg_item_nm='영업 파트') OR (trgt_tbl_nm='TB_BS_PART' AND chg_item_nm IN ('파트명','사용 여부')) ORDER BY reg_dttm,hist_id

WITH month AS (SELECT to_date(#{month},'YYYYMM') AS first_day, (to_date(#{month},'YYYYMM')+interval '1 month'-interval '1 day')::date AS last_day) SELECT a.asgn_id,d.dev_id,d.dev_nm,d.part_id,d.emp_type_cd,pay.emp_type_cd AS payroll_type, p.proj_id,p.proj_nm,p.ctrt_type_cd,a.input_type_cd,a.input_bgn_dt,d.retire_dt, (SELECT min(f.input_bgn_dt) FROM TB_PJ_ASGN f JOIN TB_PJ_PROJ fp ON fp.proj_id=f.proj_id WHERE f.dev_id=d.dev_id AND f.asgn_stat_cd!='CNCL' AND fp.ctrt_type_cd!='IN') AS first_start, COALESCE(n.mon_mm,round(COALESCE(h.mm,a.ctrt_mm)* (LEAST(a.input_end_dt,m.last_day)-GREATEST(a.input_bgn_dt,m.first_day)+1) /extract(day from m.last_day),2)) AS mm, COALESCE(n.aply_uprc,h.price,a.bill_uprc,0) AS price, pay.pay_amt,pay.vndr_sply_amt,prc.mon_pay_amt,(pay.dev_id IS NOT NULL) AS uploaded, dist.amount AS distribution,cost.amount AS allocated_cost,p.ctrt_amt,p.bdgt_amt FROM TB_PJ_ASGN a JOIN TB_HR_DEV d ON d.dev_id=a.dev_id JOIN TB_PJ_PROJ p ON p.proj_id=a.proj_id CROSS JOIN month m LEFT JOIN TB_PJ_ASGN_MON n ON n.asgn_id=a.asgn_id AND n.input_ym=#{month} LEFT JOIN TB_HR_MON_PAY pay ON pay.dev_id=d.dev_id AND pay.pay_ym=#{month} LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT x.mon_pay_amt FROM TB_HR_DEV_PRC x WHERE x.dev_id=d.dev_id AND x.aply_bgn_ym <= #{month} AND (x.aply_end_ym IS NULL OR x.aply_end_ym >= #{month}) ORDER BY x.aply_bgn_ym DESC LIMIT 1) prc ON true LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT COALESCE((SELECT CASE WHEN trim(x.bfr_val) ~ '^[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$' THEN trim(x.bfr_val)::numeric END FROM TB_PJ_ASGN_HIST x WHERE x.asgn_id=a.asgn_id AND x.aply_dt > m.last_day AND x.new_ctrt_mm IS NOT NULL ORDER BY x.aply_dt,x.hist_sn LIMIT 1), (SELECT x.new_ctrt_mm FROM TB_PJ_ASGN_HIST x WHERE x.asgn_id=a.asgn_id AND x.aply_dt <= m.last_day AND x.new_ctrt_mm IS NOT NULL ORDER BY x.aply_dt DESC,x.hist_sn DESC LIMIT 1)) AS mm, COALESCE((SELECT CASE WHEN trim(x.bfr_val) ~ '^[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$' THEN trim(x.bfr_val)::numeric END FROM TB_PJ_ASGN_HIST x WHERE x.asgn_id=a.asgn_id AND x.aply_dt > m.last_day AND x.new_uprc IS NOT NULL ORDER BY x.aply_dt,x.hist_sn LIMIT 1), (SELECT x.new_uprc FROM TB_PJ_ASGN_HIST x WHERE x.asgn_id=a.asgn_id AND x.aply_dt <= m.last_day AND x.new_uprc IS NOT NULL ORDER BY x.aply_dt DESC,x.hist_sn DESC LIMIT 1)) AS price) h ON true LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT sum(t.dstrb_amt) AS amount FROM TB_PJ_TK_DSTRB t WHERE t.proj_id=a.proj_id AND t.dev_id=a.dev_id AND t.dstrb_ym=#{month} AND t.row_type_cd='DEV' AND t.dstrb_step_cd=(SELECT z.dstrb_step_cd FROM TB_PJ_TK_DSTRB z JOIN TB_SY_CODE c ON c.code_grp_id='DSTRB_STEP' AND c.code=z.dstrb_step_cd WHERE z.proj_id=a.proj_id AND z.dev_id=a.dev_id AND z.dstrb_ym=#{month} AND z.row_type_cd='DEV' ORDER BY c.sort_ord DESC,c.code DESC LIMIT 1)) dist ON true LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT sum(c.labor_alloc_amt+c.drct_exps_amt) AS amount FROM TB_CO_MON_COST c WHERE c.proj_id=a.proj_id AND c.dev_id=a.dev_id AND c.cost_ym=#{month} AND c.cost_cls_cd='ALLOC') cost ON true WHERE a.asgn_stat_cd!='CNCL' AND p.ctrt_type_cd!='IN' AND a.input_bgn_dt <= m.last_day AND a.input_end_dt >= m.first_day AND (d.retire_dt IS NULL OR d.retire_dt >= m.first_day) ORDER BY d.dev_id,p.proj_id,a.asgn_id

SELECT x.dev_id,COALESCE(n.bfr_val,d.dev_nm) AS dev_nm,x.emp_type_cd,x.proj_nm_list,x.mm,x.uprc_amt, x.pay_amt,x.sales_exps_amt,x.retire_amt,x.cost_amt,x.diff_amt,x.prft_amt,x.rmrk FROM TB_CO_PART_SETL_DTL x JOIN TB_HR_DEV d ON d.dev_id=x.dev_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT h.bfr_val FROM TB_SY_CHG_HIST h WHERE h.trgt_tbl_nm='TB_HR_DEV' AND h.trgt_key=x.dev_id AND h.chg_item_nm='이름' AND h.reg_dttm > x.reg_dttm ORDER BY h.reg_dttm,h.hist_id LIMIT 1) n ON true WHERE x.part_id=#{partId} AND x.setl_ym=#{month} ORDER BY dev_nm,x.dev_id
SELECT code_nm FROM TB_SY_CODE WHERE code_grp_id=#{group} AND code=#{code}
